label: GO step late in the episode (trial >= 90) right after a reward that followed an unrewarded trial
explanation: Sparse feature. It fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew at D1 = 1; it is 100% of mass), and almost only in the last 10 trials of the episode (99.9% of mass at ep_trial 90-99, which matches the low-value bin: value < 5.22 holds all of it). It never fires at D1 or D2. Requiring that the trial before the rewarded one was unrewarded (a reward arriving after a non-reward) raises dev precision from 0.04 to 0.15 and keeps 92% of mass. Further enrichment: the model picking a1 (78% of mass; adding model_act == 1 gives dev F1 0.37 but mass recall 0.71), start_high == 0 episodes and good == S1. The strongest examples are a1 choices right after a rare-rewarded trial or after a run of no-reward trials. Even inside the predicate it fires on only a minority of steps, so precision is low and the gating is incomplete. Every variable used is observed or is elapsed time, so no future variables.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=GO & value_bin=decile 0 (9 = highest) (+4.52), phase=GO & ep_dec=9 (+3.51), phase=GO & before=a2 S1 u (+2.67), phase=GO & last=a1 S1 r (+2.61), phase=GO & last=a2 S1 r (+2.06), phase=GO & before=a2 S2 u (+1.72). Lower it: before=a1 S1 r (-3.77), last=a2 S2 u (-2.24), prev_state=2 (-2.18), last=a1 S1 u (-2.14).
